baseline_reference.hardware_note: Existing PRO 6000 full baseline; cross-hardware comparison only, no new AR run

change: Selection score only: uniform mean -> 0.25 * first-half mean + 0.75 * second-half mean; memory quality remains uniform
hypothesis: Later continuation confidence may distinguish a sustained reasoning direction from an easy opening. Final-answer accuracy, not resource savings, determines success.

previous_pilot.note: Prior 60-question selfcorrect pilot; fresh uniform control is the primary comparison

primary_metric: Final-answer correctness on identical IDs, task accuracies and paired wins/losses; completion and time are secondary metrics
runtime_caveat: Fresh Ours control and candidate use matching GPU counts, batching maxima, seeds, budgets and scorer; dynamic execution paths can still differ. A single small pilot cannot establish a universal gain.
scope: development accuracy pilot, not canonical full-cohort submission
selection_note: Same 60 preselected development IDs reused without redraw; no held-out confirmation claim
